messages:
Alex: FYI — AcmeTeam says promo code ACME50 didn't apply and some users were billed instead. They attached a screenshot and a txn id. :frowning:
Priya: can you drop the campaign id and an example account?
Alex: campaign_id=camp_9832, acct_112 affected. Tried on web + API. API returned 400.
Jordan: grabbing logs for camp_9832. any repro steps from the customer?
Alex: repro we used: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/promos/apply -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"code":"ACME50","account_id":"acct_112"}' -> 400 {"error":"promo_not_active","message":"Promo not active yet"}
Maya: looking at DB — start_date for camp_9832 is 2026-05-01T00:00:00Z. Created yesterday via CSV import. That start_date is > today. :eyes:
Jordan: also seeing redemption_limit = 0 in the row. CSV import parsed empty limit as 0. That explains why apply never granted credit.
Carlos: confirmed. CSV had blank "redemption_limit" column; import code sets 0. We should treat blank as unlimited/default.
Priya: action items: (1) hotfix import behavior to treat empty as NULL/unlimited, (2) push migration to correct existing campaigns with 0 where blank was intended, (3) manually remediate affected accounts.
Jordan: quick patch PR: https://git.redwood/camp/PR-452 — changes parser to default NULL and validate start/end date ordering.
EngOncallBot: deploy started for branch camp-import-fix (build #284).
Priya: remediation — manually granting credits to affected accounts now. Using internal CLI:
```
redwood promo grant --campaign camp_9832 --accounts acct_112,acct_245,acct_398 --amount 50 --reason "CSV import bug"
```
Alex: reached out to AcmeTeam support contact, confirmed acct_112 has +50 credits, they got an in-app notice. Sent apology + extra 20 free credits for trouble. :party_parrot:
Jordan: created DB migration to convert redemption_limit=0 -> NULL for imports where original CSV had blank. PR: https://git.redwood/camp/PR-453
Maya: also opening PLAT ticket to add an import preview UI and stronger validation for start/end dates (PLAT-1078). We should prevent future mis-parses (common date formats + timezone).
Priya: billing follow-up: please audit any invoices/charges that occurred while code was unavailable and refund if needed. tagging billing-bot.
BillingBot: noted. Assigned invoice audit: inv_778 -> owner Carlos.
Carlos: will audit charges and create refunds/orders where appropriate. ETA EOD.
Alex: customer escalated to CSM earlier this morning; CSM updated and is satisfied with credits + refund plan. Thanks team.
Priya: will keep this thread open until migration & deploy are in prod. Planning a short postmortem if we see more than 5 affected accounts.
Jordan: postmortem ready draft link: https://docs.redwood/postmortems/camp-import-176999 (will fill after deploy).
Alex: closing loop for now. Great triage. :thumbsup:
